readout_other: self-reported meditative depth and intensity; POMS, TMS, NADA, EDI, MEDI, BSQ questionnaires; heart rate, HRV and respiration rate
direction_notes: In the pilot cohort, caudate stimulation was reported to increase meditative depth and HRV and reduce heart rate compared with sham; PCC mainly changed subjective intensity. Preliminary, not tested with the planned analysis.
safety_notes: Safety argued from simulated in-situ intensities and prior literature; no adverse event reporting in the pilot cohort is given.

timing.protocol_description: 12 minutes of stimulation beginning after minute 12 of a 60-minute meditation, delivered in 10-second on-off blocks; for the bilateral targets 6 minutes to each hemisphere sequentially (PCC is a single transducer for 12 minutes).
